walkable.title: Walkable neighborhood
walkable.description: Connect at least two visible ground-level homes to a workplace, shop and park by walking routes no longer than 64 walking units. Check routes after editing. Nearby targets are checked first; the checker considers up to eight homes and eight targets of each type.

apartment.title: Apartment on a budget
apartment.description: Furnish the challenge apartment with seating, a table, a light and storage. Keep all construction spending within 600 credits. Starting this challenge empties the selected building's room, or creates an apartment if none is selected, and starts a new city budget. The original city can be restored with Undo.

construction.title: Foundation construction contract
construction.description: Haul masonry from a stocked shipping container to a site office. On foot, install two barriers and set the foundation reinforcement. The reward and installed equipment last for this Walk session.
